on calcAlbumSettings me
  album_r = gRock.m_classManager.createObj(#album)
  album_r.ID = gRock.m_classManager.genUniqueID(album_r)
  band_r = gRock.m_context.getFocus(#Band)
  band_r.calcStyleMix()
  gRock.m_classManager.copy(m_song_r.StyleMix, album_r.MusicStyle)
  album_r.SongType = m_song_r.SongType
  numUsedChannels = 0
  qualityList = [:]
  repeat with n = 1 to channelObjs.count()
    chObj = channelObjs[n]
    if not objectp(chObj.m_loopObj_r) then
      next repeat
    end if
    if chObj.getSetting(#Mute) = 1 then
      next repeat
    end if
    if not objectp(chObj.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r) then
      next repeat
    end if
    vol = chObj.getSetting(#vol)
    vol = vol / 100.0
    if vol > 0.29999999999999999 then
      weight = 1.0
    else
      weight = vol / 0.29999999999999999
    end if
    if vol > 0 then
      numUsedChannels = numUsedChannels + 1
    end if
    instrumentID = chObj.m_loopObj_r.Instrument
    if instrumentID = #Vocals then
      weight = weight * 1.30000000000000004
    end if
    Musicality = rgetProp(chObj.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r, #Musicality)
    if objectp(Musicality) then
      Musicality = Musicality.Current
    end if
    qualityList.addProp(weight, Musicality)
    tmpStyleMix = rCreateCopy(chObj.m_loopObj_r.StyleMix)
    gRock.m_classManager.multiply(tmpStyleMix, weight)
    gRock.m_classManager.add(album_r.MusicStyle, tmpStyleMix)
  end repeat
  tuneDebug("ChannelsQuality", qualityList)
  channelsQuality = calcAverage(qualityList)
  calcMixerSettingEffectsOnResult(channelObjs, album_r)
  musician_r = band_r.getMusicianPlaying(#Vocals)
  if objectp(musician_r) then
    rCalcObjsAverage(album_r.MusicStyle, [1.0: album_r.MusicStyle, 0.20000000000000001: musician_r.MusicStyle])
  end if
  numUsedChannelsQualityChangeList = [-0.29999999999999999, -0.20000000000000001, -0.10000000000000001, 0.0, 0, 1, 0.14999999999999999, 0.20000000000000001]
  if numUsedChannels > numUsedChannelsQualityChangeList.count then
    numChQualityChange = numUsedChannelsQualityChangeList[numUsedChannelsQualityChangeList.count]
  else
    numChQualityChange = numUsedChannelsQualityChangeList[numUsedChannels]
  end if
  album_r.quality = numChQualityChange + calcAverage([0.25: m_song_r.quality, 1: channelsQuality, 0.25: m_studio_r.quality])
  if album_r.quality < 0 then
    album_r.quality = 0
  else
    if album_r.quality > 1 then
      album_r.quality = 1
    end if
  end if
  tmpProps = gRock.m_classManager.getPropsInClass(album_r.MusicStyle.className)
  repeat with propNr = 1 to tmpProps.count
    prop = tmpProps.getPropAt(propNr)
    val = rgetProp(album_r.MusicStyle, prop)
    if val < 0 then
      rsetPropSimple(album_r.MusicStyle, prop, 0)
      next repeat
    end if
    if val > 1 then
      rsetPropSimple(album_r.MusicStyle, prop, 1)
    end if
  end repeat
  rCalcObjsAverage(album_r.ImageStyle, [1.0: band_r.MusicStyle])
  tuneDebug("Quality: Song", m_song_r.quality, "Channels", channelsQuality, "Studio", m_studio_r.quality, "NumChannels:", numChQualityChange, "Total", album_r.quality)
  tuneDebugObject(album_r.MusicStyle, "MusicStyle")
  tuneDebug("SongType", album_r.SongType)
  album_r.recorded(m_song_r)
end

on calcMusiciansReactions me
  band_r = gRock.m_context.getFocus(#Band)
  musicians_r = []
  repeat with n = 1 to band_r.members.count
    musID = band_r.members[n]
    musician_r = gRock.m_classManager.getObjByIDAndClass(musID, #RealMusician)
    musicians_r.add(musician_r)
  end repeat
  whoNormallyPlaysInstrument = [:]
  repeat with n = 1 to musicians_r.count
    musician_r = musicians_r[n]
    othersPlayingThat = whoNormallyPlaysInstrument.getaProp(musician_r.NowPlaying)
    if voidp(othersPlayingThat) then
      othersPlayingThat = []
      whoNormallyPlaysInstrument.setaProp(musician_r.NowPlaying, othersPlayingThat)
    end if
    othersPlayingThat.add(musician_r)
  end repeat
  volPerMusician = [:]
  bandTotalVol = 0.0
  repeat with n = 1 to channelObjs.count()
    chObj = channelObjs[n]
    if not objectp(chObj.m_loopObj_r) then
      next repeat
    end if
    if chObj.getSetting(#Mute) = 1 then
      next repeat
    end if
    if chObj.getSetting(#vol) = 0 then
      next repeat
    end if
    if not objectp(chObj.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r) then
      next repeat
    end if
    vol = chObj.getSetting(#vol)
    whosPlaying_r = chObj.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r
    Instrument = chObj.m_loopObj_r.Instrument
    if whosPlaying_r.className = #StudioMusician then
      if 0 then
        normallyPlays = whoNormallyPlaysInstrument.getaProp(Instrument)
        if listp(normallyPlays) then
          repeat with musician_r in normallyPlays
            angryFact = -0.20000000000000001 * (whosPlaying_r.Selfperception + 1) / 2
            rCreateModifier(#StudioMusician, musician_r.ID, #Mood, angryFact, 10)
            pott("Studiomusician is playing my instrument!", musician_r.ID)
          end repeat
        end if
      end if
      next repeat
    end if
    totVol = volPerMusician.getaProp(whosPlaying_r)
    if voidp(totVol) then
      totVol = 0.0
    end if
    totVol = totVol + vol
    volPerMusician.setaProp(whosPlaying_r, totVol)
    bandTotalVol = bandTotalVol + vol
  end repeat
  repeat with musician_r in musicians_r
    if voidp(volPerMusician.getaProp(musician_r)) then
      volPerMusician.addProp(musician_r, 0)
    end if
  end repeat
  if volPerMusician.count = 0 then
  else
    averageVol = bandTotalVol / volPerMusician.count
    angriestVolMusician_r = 0
    worstVolFraction = 1
    repeat with musician_r in musicians_r
      angryThreshold = (0.34999999999999998 * (musician_r.Selfperception + 1)) + 0.10000000000000001
      volFraction = volPerMusician.getaProp(musician_r) / averageVol
      pott("Angry?", musician_r.ID, angryThreshold, volFraction, volPerMusician.getaProp(musician_r), averageVol)
      if volFraction < angryThreshold then
        tmp = volFraction / angryThreshold
        if tmp < worstVolFraction then
          worstVolFraction = tmp
          angriestVolMusician_r = musician_r
        end if
      end if
    end repeat
    if objectp(angriestVolMusician_r) then
      angryFact = 0.20000000000000001
      rCreateModifier(#StudioLowVol, angriestVolMusician_r.ID, #Mood, angryFact, 10)

end

on mouse me, argObj, argWhat
  if argWhat = #down then
    case argObj.ID of
      #Mute:
        if me.getSetting(#Mute) > 0 then
          me.setSetting(#Mute, 0)
        else
          me.setSetting(#Mute, 1)
        end if
      #FX:
        me.openSettings()
      #Instrument:
        me.openSettings()
    end case
  end if
end

on openSettings me
  m_mixerObj.stop()
  if channelMusicianObj.gotMusician() = 0 then
    gDir.m_objDialogsMaster.openDialog(#MixerChooseMusician, [#ReportTo: me, #Instrument: VOID, #CurrentlyPlaying: VOID, #StudioMusicianIDs: m_mixerObj.m_studio_r.StudioMusicians])
  else
    obj = gDir.m_objDialogsMaster.openDialog(#MixerFX, [#channelObj: me, #FXObjs: m_fxObjs])
    obj.init()
  end if
end

on Report me, argObj, argWhat, argOptions
  tmpPos = controllerObjs.getPos(argObj)
  if tmpPos then
    tmpID = controllerObjs.getPropAt(tmpPos)
    case tmpID of
      #volume:
        argOptions = 100 - integer(100 * argOptions)
        me.setSetting(#vol, argOptions)
      #Frequency:
        me.setSetting(#freq, argOptions)
      #Pan:
        if argWhat = #changed then
          me.setSetting(#Pan, argOptions)
        end if
    end case
  else
    if argWhat = #ClosedFX then
      gDir.m_waveRenderer.m_doWhatWhenDoneList = [#ReportTo: m_mixerObj, #handler: #playSoon]
      gDir.m_waveRenderer.renderQueue()
    else
      if argWhat = #ChoseMusician then
        channelMusicianObj.setMusician(argOptions[#Musician])
        tmpLst = m_mixerObj.getLoops(argOptions[#Instrument])
        tmpOKLoop_r = tmpLst[1]
        tmpLst = tmpLst.duplicate()
        repeat with obj in m_mixerObj.channelObjs
          if objectp(obj.m_loopObj_r) then
            tmpLst.deleteOne(obj.m_loopObj_r)
          end if
        end repeat
        if tmpLst.count then
          tmpOKLoop_r = tmpLst[1]
        end if
        me.prepareLoop(tmpOKLoop_r)
        if m_settings[#vol] = 0 then
          me.setSetting(#vol, 70, #Gfx)
        end if
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.m_doWhatWhenDoneList = [#ReportTo: m_mixerObj, #handler: #playSoon]
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.renderQueue()
      end if
    end if
  end if
end

on prepareLoop me, argLoopObj
  if argLoopObj = #next then
    argLoopObj = 1
  end if
  if integerp(argLoopObj) then
    if not objectp(m_loopObj_r) then
      exit
    end if
    tmpLst = m_mixerObj.getLoops(m_loopObj_r.Instrument)
    tmpPos = tmpLst.getPos(m_loopObj_r)
    tmpPos = tmpPos + argLoopObj
    if tmpPos > tmpLst.count then
      tmpPos = tmpLst.count
    else
      if tmpPos < 1 then
        tmpPos = 1
      end if
    end if
    argLoopObj = tmpLst[tmpPos]
  else
    if voidp(argLoopObj) or (argLoopObj = #Current) then
      if objectp(m_loopObj_r) then
        argLoopObj = m_loopObj_r
      end if
    end if
  end if
  m_loopObj_r = argLoopObj
  if objectp(m_loopObj_r) then
    ID = m_loopObj_r.Instrument
    instObj = gRock.m_classManager.getObjByID(ID)
  end if
  if objectp(instObj) then
    instMembName = instObj.Gfx & "02"
  else
    instMembName = "icon_cancel01"
  end if
  m_SPInstrument.member = instMembName
  if not objectp(m_loopObj_r) then
    exit
  end if
  m_orgFile = me.fixPossibleVocalFileName(m_loopObj_r)
  if objectp(m_track) then
    m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.deleteTrack(m_track)
    m_track = m_track.kill()
  end if
  if channelMusicianObj.gotMusician() = 0 then
    exit
  end if
  isPlaying = 0
  LoopType = rgetProp(m_loopObj_r, #LoopType)
  if LoopType = #MIDI then
    m_track = script("TrackScript").new(m_mixerObj.m_sequencer)
    m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.addTrack(m_track)
  else
    channelMusicianObj.modifyLoop(m_loopObj_r, m_orgFile)
    m_track = script("TrackLoopScript").new(m_mixerObj.m_sequencer)
    m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.addLoopTrack(m_track)
  end if
  m_isLoaded = 0
end

on fixPossibleVocalFileName me, argLoopObj
  if argLoopObj.Instrument = #Vocals then
    if offset("All", argLoopObj.file) then
      return argLoopObj.file
    end if
    tmpMus_r = channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r
    if objectp(tmpMus_r) then
      if tmpMus_r.className = #RealMusician then
        tmpSingerSuffix = tmpMus_r.getSoundFilePrefix()
      end if
    end if
    if not stringp(tmpSingerSuffix) then
      pott("Can't sing!")
      tmpSingerSuffix = "a01"
    end if
    return argLoopObj.file & tmpSingerSuffix
  end if
  return argLoopObj.file
end

on play me
  global gDir
  if m_isLoaded = 1 then
    exit
  end if
  if not objectp(m_loopObj_r) then
    exit
  end if
  if not objectp(m_track) then
    exit
  end if
  LoopType = rgetProp(m_loopObj_r, #LoopType)
  if LoopType = #MIDI then
    m_track.load(member("TrkSq" & m_orgFile).text.value, 2)
  else
    m_renderedFile = gDir.m_waveRenderer.getRendered(channelNum, m_orgFile)
    m_renderedFile = fileExtractName(m_renderedFile)
    m_track.setSetting(#file, m_renderedFile)
    repeat with n = 1 to m_settings.count
      me.setSetting(m_settings.getPropAt(n), m_settings[n])
    end repeat
  end if
  m_isLoaded = 1
end

on stop me
  isPlaying = 0
end

on atEnd me
  return 0
end

on setSetting me, argProp, argVal, argChangeGfx
  if not voidp(argVal) then
    m_settings[argProp] = argVal
  end if
  if argProp = #vol then
    if argChangeGfx = #Gfx then
      tmpObj = controllerObjs[#volume]
      tmpObj.setFactor(argVal / 100.0)
    end if
    if voidp(argVal) then
      argVal = me.getSetting(#vol)
    end if
    argVal = argVal * m_mixerObj.m_masterVolFact
    if objectp(m_track) then
      m_track.setSetting(#vol, integer(argVal))
    end if
  else
    if argProp = #Pan then
      if argChangeGfx = #Gfx then
        tmpObj = controllerObjs[#Pan]
        tmpObj.setMinMaxRelVal(argVal)
      end if
      if objectp(m_track) then
        m_track.setSetting(#Pan, argVal)
      end if
    else
      if argProp = #freq then
        if floatp(argVal) then
          argVal = argVal * 2
          if abs(argVal - 1.0) < 0.05 then
            argVal = 1.0
          end if
        else
        end if
      else
        if argProp = #Mute then
          if objectp(m_track) then
            m_track.setSetting(#Mute, argVal)
          end if
        end if
      end if
    end if
  end if
end

on getSetting me, argProp
  return m_settings[argProp]
end

on getEffects me, argLoop_r
  if voidp(argLoop_r) then
    argLoop_r = m_loopObj_r
  end if
  if not objectp(argLoop_r) then
    exit
  end if
  tmp = me.calcLoopRenderTempo(argLoop_r)
  repeat with n = 1 to m_fxObjs.count
    ID = m_fxObjs.getPropAt(n)
    obj = m_fxObjs[n]
    if ilk(obj) = #instance then
      lst = obj.getSettings()
      if lst[#Active] then
        tmp.setaProp(obj.m_fxName, lst)
      end if
      next repeat
    end if
    if obj[#Active] = 1 then
      tmp.setaProp(ID, obj)
    end if
  end repeat
  return tmp
end

on calcLoopRenderTempo me, argLoop_r
  TimeSig = m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.m_beatSignature
  timeStr = string(TimeSig[1]) & "/" & string(TimeSig[2])
  tmpBPM = float(m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.m_bpm)
  if not (argLoop_r.BPM > 0) then
    argLoop_r.BPM = 120
  end if
  if (tmpBPM / argLoop_r.BPM) < 0.80000000000000004 then
    tmpBPM = tmpBPM * 2
  end if
  return [#tempo: [#BPM: tmpBPM, #Bars: argLoop_r.numBars, #TimeSig: timeStr]]
end

on getMixDownParams me
  if not objectp(m_loopObj_r) then
    return 0
  end if
  if not stringp(m_renderedFile) then
    return 0
  end if
  if m_renderedFile.length = 0 then
    return 0
  end if
  if me.getSetting(#Mute) = 1 then
    return 0
  end if
  tmpFullPath = gRock.m_paths.getPath(#RenderedMusic) & m_renderedFile
  return [#file: tmpFullPath, #vol: me.getSetting(#vol) / 100.0]
end

on setMusician me, argObj
  channelMusicianObj.setMusician(argObj)
end

property ancestor, m_dlg, m_fxGfxObjs, m_fxObjs, m_channel, m_sndObj, m_renderProtectMouseObj, m_waitingForRenderer, m_loop_r, m_instrument, m_CPFile

on playPreview me
  global gDir
  m_waitingForRenderer = 0
  file = gDir.m_waveRenderer.getRendered("preview", m_CPFile)
  file = fileExtractName(file)
  m_sndObj = script("SoundScript").new(gDir.m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.m_soundPath & file, [#ReportTo: me, #PlayDirect: 1])
end

on mouse me, argObj, argWhat, argOption
  if argWhat = #click then
    if objectp(argOption) then
      if argOption.ID = #ButtonOK then
        if m_waitingForRenderer then
          exit
        end if
        m_waitingForRenderer = 1
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = script("MouseObject").new(me, rect(0, 0, 1000, 1000), [#layer: 1000000, #noPassRoll: 1, #cursorRoll: #wait])
        FX = m_channel.getEffects(m_loop_r)
        m_CPFile = m_channel.fixPossibleVocalFileName(m_loop_r)
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.queueRendering("preview", m_CPFile, FX)
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.m_doWhatWhenDoneList = [#ReportTo: me, #handler: #playPreview]
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.renderQueue()
      else
        if argOption.ID = #ButtonCancel then
          m_channel.prepareLoop(m_loop_r)
          m_channel.Report(me, #ClosedFX)
          me.kill()
        else
          if argOption.ID = #Pic then
            me.launchMusicianDlg()
          else
            if argOption.ID = #ArrowUp then
              me.changeLoop(-1)
            else
              if argOption.ID = #ArrowDown then
                me.changeLoop(1)
              end if
            end if
          end if
        end if
      end if
    else
      if argObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj then
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj.kill()
        if objectp(m_sndObj) then
          m_sndObj = m_sndObj.kill()
        end if
      end if
    end if
  end if
end

on changeLoop me, argDir
  tmpLst = gDir.m_mixerObj.getLoops(m_instrument)
  if listp(tmpLst) then
    tmpPos = tmpLst.getPos(m_loop_r)
    tmpPos = tmpPos + argDir
    if tmpPos > tmpLst.count then
      tmpPos = tmpLst.count
    else
      if tmpPos < 1 then
        tmpPos = 1

property m_dlg, m_master, m_ctrls, m_type, m_ctrlDefs, m_fxObj

on new me, argMasterFXObj, argFXType, argFXObj
  m_master = argMasterFXObj
  m_type = argFXType
  m_fxObj = argFXObj
  m_dlg = script("Dialog").new([#image: m_master.m_dlg.myImagePtr, #OKtoResize: 0])
  itemLists = []
  gfxList = m_fxObj.getGFX()
  knobIDs = []
  repeat with n = 1 to gfxList.count
    ID = gfxList.getPropAt(n)
    lst = gfxList[n]
    tmpLoc = lst[#loc]
    if lst[#type] = #Knob then
      itemLists.add([#ID: ID, #ch: n, #type: #Pic, #ink: 36, #Pic: "small_ratt01_0000", #inOffsetRect: rect(tmpLoc, point(0, 0)), #rel: [0, 0, #Auto, #Auto], #topLeftMeansWhat: [#Reg, #Reg]])
      knobIDs.add(lst[#ID])
      next repeat
    end if
    if lst[#type] = #button then
      tmpPic = lst[#Pic]
      if voidp(tmpPic) then
        tmpPic = "button_mute01"
      end if
      itemLists.add([#ID: ID, #ch: n, #type: #button, #ink: 36, #Pic: tmpPic, #PicDownName: "1", #inOffsetRect: rect(tmpLoc, point(0, 0)), #rel: [0, 0, #Auto, #Auto], #Toggle: 1, #topLeftMeansWhat: [#Reg, #Reg]])
      next repeat
    end if
    if lst[#type] = #Pic then
      itemLists.add([#ID: ID, #ch: n, #type: #Pic, #ink: 8, #Pic: lst[#Pic], #inOffsetRect: rect(tmpLoc, point(0, 0)), #rel: [0, 0, #Auto, #Auto], #usingMouse: 0])
    end if
  end repeat
  m_dlg.rawCreate(itemLists)
  m_ctrls = [:]
  repeat with n = 1 to gfxList.count
    ID = gfxList.getPropAt(n)
    val = m_fxObj.getGfxVal(ID)
    if voidp(val) then
      next repeat
    end if
    itemObj = m_dlg.getItem(ID)
    type = gfxList[ID][#type]
    if type = #Knob then
      BH = script("DialogKnobBH").new(itemObj, [#ReportTo: me, #ID: ID, #firstFrame: "small_ratt01_0000", #val: val, #numFrames: 64])
      m_ctrls[ID] = BH
      itemObj.scriptInstanceList.addAt(1, BH)
    else
      if type = #button then
        itemObj.isDown = val
        itemObj.scriptInstanceList.addAt(1, me)
      else
        if type = #Pic then
          itemObj.setOneProp(#Pic, val)
        end if
      end if
    end if
    m_fxObj.Report(me, ID, val)
  end repeat
  return me
end

on kill me
  return 0
end

on mouse me, argObj, argWhat, argOption
  if argWhat = #click then
    if objectp(argOption) then
      if argOption[#type] = #button then
        m_fxObj.Report(me, argOption.ID, argOption.isDown)
      end if
    end if
  end if
end

on Report me, argObj, argWhat, argOption
  m_fxObj.Report(me, argObj.ID, argOption)
end

property ancestor, m_dlg, m_fxGfxObjs, m_fxObjs, m_channel, m_sndObj, m_renderProtectMouseObj, m_waitingForRenderer, m_loop_r, m_instrument, m_CPFile
global gDir, gRock

on new me, argOptions
  argOptions.setaProp(#ReportTo, me)
  argOptions.setaProp(#child, me)
  m_channel = argOptions[#channelObj]
  m_fxObjs = argOptions[#FXObjs]
  if not listp(m_fxObjs) then
    m_fxObjs = [:]
  end if
  if m_fxObjs.count = 0 then
    studio_r = gRock.m_context.getFocus(#Studio)
    repeat with FXID in studio_r.AvailableFX
      scriptName = string(FXID) & "Script"
      if member(scriptName).number > 0 then
        m_fxObjs.addProp(FXID, script(scriptName).new())
        next repeat
      end if
      pott("FX undefined", FXID)
    end repeat
  end if
  m_waitingForRenderer = 0
  ancestor = script("DlgRockAncestorScript").new(argOptions)
  m_dlg = ancestor.m_objDlg
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItem(#close)
  if objectp(itemObj) then
    itemObj.scriptInstanceList.addAt(1, me)
  end if
  return me
end

on init me
  m_fxGfxObjs = []
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItem(#FXDummy)
  itemObj.setOneProp(#Pic, "Dummy")
  rct = itemObj.getOneProp(#inOffsetRect).duplicate()
  rel = itemObj.getOneProp(#rel).duplicate()
  repeat with n = 1 to m_fxObjs.count
    fxObj = m_fxObjs[n]
    fxType = m_fxObjs.getPropAt(n)
    obj = script("FXGfxScript").new(me, fxType, fxObj)
    lst = [#ID: symbol("FX" & string(n)), #type: #Dialog, #inOffsetRect: rct, #rel: rel, #dialogDataMemberName: "DlgSimpleData", #ch: n + 1, #usingMouse: 0]
    newObj = m_dlg.addItem(lst)
    newObj.attachDlg(obj.m_dlg)
    m_fxGfxObjs.add(obj)
    rel = rel.duplicate()
    rel[2] = [lst[#ID], 4]
    rct = rct.duplicate()
    rct[2] = -10
  end repeat
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItem(#Chooser)
  rel = itemObj.getOneProp(#rel)
  rel[2] = [lst[#ID], 4]
  itemObj.setOneProp(#rel, rel)
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItemByPath([#MusicianSheet, #Pic])
  itemObj.scriptInstanceList.add(me)
  m_loop_r = m_channel.m_loopObj_r
  if objectp(m_loop_r) then
    m_instrument = m_loop_r.Instrument
  else
    m_instrument = #Guitar
  end if
  tmpMus_r = rgetProp(m_channel, [#channelMusicianObj, #m_musician_r])
  me.setMusician(tmpMus_r)
  itemObj = ancestor.m_objDlg.getItemByPath([#Chooser, #text])
  r = itemObj.getOneProp(#inOffsetRect)
  r[3] = 238
  itemObj.setOneProp(#inOffsetRect, r)
  me.changeLoop(0)
  ancestor.render()
  if not objectp(tmpMus_r) then
    me.launchMusicianDlg()
  end if
end

on kill me
  repeat with obj in m_fxGfxObjs
    obj.kill()
  end repeat
  m_fxGfxObjs = []
  if objectp(m_renderProtectMouseObj) then
    m_renderProtectMouseObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj.kill()
  end if
  if objectp(m_sndObj) then
    m_sndObj = m_sndObj.kill()
  end if
  ancestor = ancestor.kill()
  return me
end

on setMusician me, argMusician_r
  setMixerMusicianInfoSheet(argMusician_r, m_dlg, m_instrument)
end

on Report me, argObj, argWhat, argOption
  if (argObj = m_sndObj) and objectp(argObj) then
    if argWhat = #finished then
      gDir.m_waveRenderer.m_doWhatWhenDoneList = [#ReportTo: 0, #handler: 0]
      m_renderProtectMouseObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj.kill()
      if objectp(m_sndObj) then
        m_sndObj = m_sndObj.kill()
      end if
    end if
  else
    if argWhat = #ChoseMusician then
      musician_r = argOption[#Musician]
      m_instrument = argOption[#Instrument]
      m_channel.channelMusicianObj.setMusician(musician_r)
      me.changeLoop(0)
      me.setMusician(musician_r)
    end if
  end if
end

on launchMusicianDlg me
  gDir.m_objDialogsMaster.openDialog(#MixerChooseMusician, [#ReportTo: me, #Instrument: m_instrument, #CurrentlyPlaying: m_channel.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r, #StudioMusicianIDs: gDir.m_mixerObj.m_studio_r.StudioMusicians])
end

on playPreview me
  global gDir
  m_waitingForRenderer = 0
  file = gDir.m_waveRenderer.getRendered("preview", m_CPFile)
  file = fileExtractName(file)
  m_sndObj = script("SoundScript").new(gDir.m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.m_soundPath & file, [#ReportTo: me, #PlayDirect: 1])
end

on mouse me, argObj, argWhat, argOption
  if argWhat = #click then
    if objectp(argOption) then
      if argOption.ID = #ButtonOK then
        if m_waitingForRenderer then
          exit
        end if
        m_waitingForRenderer = 1
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = script("MouseObject").new(me, rect(0, 0, 1000, 1000), [#layer: 1000000, #noPassRoll: 1, #cursorRoll: #wait])
        FX = m_channel.getEffects(m_loop_r)
        m_CPFile = m_channel.fixPossibleVocalFileName(m_loop_r)
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.queueRendering("preview", m_CPFile, FX)
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.m_doWhatWhenDoneList = [#ReportTo: me, #handler: #playPreview]
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.renderQueue()
      else
        if argOption.ID = #ButtonCancel then
          m_channel.prepareLoop(m_loop_r)
          m_channel.Report(me, #ClosedFX)
          me.kill()
        else
          if argOption.ID = #Pic then
            me.launchMusicianDlg()
          else
            if argOption.ID = #ArrowUp then
              me.changeLoop(-1)
            else
              if argOption.ID = #ArrowDown then
                me.changeLoop(1)
              end if
            end if
          end if
        end if
      end if
    else
      if argObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj then
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj.kill()
        if objectp(m_sndObj) then
          m_sndObj = m_sndObj.kill()
        end if
      end if
    end if
  end if
end

on changeLoop me, argDir
  tmpLst = gDir.m_mixerObj.getLoops(m_instrument)
  if listp(tmpLst) then
    tmpPos = tmpLst.getPos(m_loop_r)
    tmpPos = tmpPos + argDir
    if tmpPos > tmpLst.count then
      tmpPos = tmpLst.count
    else
      if tmpPos < 1 then
        tmpPos = 1
      end if
    end if
    m_loop_r = tmpLst[tmpPos]
  else
    m_loop_r = 0
  end if
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItemByPath([#Chooser, #text])
  if objectp(m_loop_r) then
    itemObj.setOneProp(#editData, m_loop_r.name)
  else
    itemObj.setOneProp(#editData, EMPTY)
  end if
end

end

    m_dlgOKButton = m_dlgOKButton.kill()

    m_progressObj = m_progressObj.kill()
  end if

end

on progressInit me, argNumFiles
  if objectp(m_progressObj) then
    m_progressObj = m_progressObj.kill()
  end if
  if argNumFiles < 2 then
    exit
  end if
  m_progressObj = script("FakeDlgProgressBarScript").new(VOID, argNumFiles)
end

on progressReport me, arg
  if objectp(m_progressObj) then
    m_progressObj.progressReport()
    if m_progressObj.m_partDone = 1 then
      m_progressObj = m_progressObj.kill()
    end if
  end if
end

property m_ctrlVals, m_ctrlRanges, m_fxName, m_textMemberName

on new me
  m_fxName = #reverb
  m_ctrlRanges = [#Mix: [#range: [#min: 0.0, #max: 1.0]]]
  m_textMemberName = "NoteText"
  m_ctrlVals = [#Active: 0, #Mix: 0.5]
  return me
end

on kill me
  return 0
end

on getGFX me
  defs = [#BG: [#type: #Pic, #Pic: "background_mixer_effect_delay01", #loc: point(0, 0)], #Active: [#type: #button, #loc: point(60, 36)], #Mix: [#type: #Knob, #loc: point(161, 0)]]
  return defs
end

on openedDlg me, argDlg
end

on Report me, argObj, argWhat, argOption
  ID = argWhat
  m_ctrlVals[ID] = argOption
end

on getGfxVal me, argID
  val = m_ctrlVals[argID]
  return val
end

on getCtrlSetting me, argID
  val = m_ctrlVals[argID]
  tmpRangeInfo = m_ctrlRanges.getaProp(argID)
  if listp(tmpRangeInfo) then
    rng = tmpRangeInfo[#range]
    diff = rng[#max] - rng[#min]
    val = (val * diff) + rng[#min]
  end if
  return val
end

on getSettings me
  global gRock
  lst = [:]
  repeat with n = 1 to m_ctrlVals.count
    ID = m_ctrlVals.getPropAt(n)
    lst.addProp(ID, me.getCtrlSetting(ID))
  end repeat
  lst.addProp(#wave, gRock.m_paths.getPath(#music) & "IRHallway2.wav")
  return lst
end

property m_dlg, m_fxGfxObjs, m_fxObjs, m_channel, m_sndObj, m_protectMouseObj, m_renderProtectMouseObj, m_waitingForRenderer
global gDir, gRock

on new me, argChannelObj, argFXObjs
  m_channel = argChannelObj
  m_fxObjs = argFXObjs
  if not listp(m_fxObjs) then
    m_fxObjs = [:]
  end if
  if m_fxObjs.count = 0 then
    studio_r = gRock.m_context.getFocus(#Studio)
    repeat with FXID in studio_r.AvailableFX
      scriptName = string(FXID) & "Script"
      if member(scriptName).number > 0 then
        m_fxObjs.addProp(FXID, script(scriptName).new())
        next repeat
      end if
      pott("FX undefined", FXID)
    end repeat
  end if
  m_dlg = script("Dialog").new([#AttachImageToMember: #temp, #StartSpriteNum: gDir.m_spriteList[#FX], #NumSprites: 2, #OKtoResize: 1])
  sprite(gDir.m_spriteList[#FX]).ink = 8
  lst = member("DlgMixerFXData").text.value
  m_dlg.rawCreate(lst)
  obj = m_dlg.getItem(#BG)
  if objectp(obj) then
    obj.setOneProp(#rel, [0, 0, [#ZYXSrnd, 3], [#ZYXSrnd, 4]])
    obj.setOneProp(#inOffsetRect, rect(0, 0, 10, 16))
  end if
  obj = m_dlg.getItem(#close)
  if objectp(obj) then
    obj.scriptInstanceList.addAt(1, me)
  end if
  m_protectMouseObj = script("MouseObject").new(me, rect(0, 0, 1000, 1000), [#layer: 100, #noPassRoll: 1, #cursorRoll: #NoClick])
  m_waitingForRenderer = 0
  return me
end

on init me
  m_fxGfxObjs = []
  lastRel = [#FramedText, 4]
  extraSpace = 20
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItem(#FXDummy)
  itemObj.setOneProp(#Pic, "Dummy")
  rct = itemObj.getOneProp(#inOffsetRect).duplicate()
  rel = itemObj.getOneProp(#rel).duplicate()
  pott(rct)
  repeat with n = 1 to m_fxObjs.count
    fxObj = m_fxObjs[n]
    fxType = m_fxObjs.getPropAt(n)
    obj = script("FXGfxScript").new(me, fxType, fxObj)
    lst = [#ID: symbol("FX" & string(n)), #type: #Dialog, #inOffsetRect: rct, #rel: rel, #dialogDataMemberName: "DlgSimpleData", #ch: n + 1, #usingMouse: 0]
    newObj = m_dlg.addItem(lst)
    newObj.attachDlg(obj.m_dlg)
    m_fxGfxObjs.add(obj)
    rel = rel.duplicate()
    rel[2] = [lst[#ID], 4]
    rct = rct.duplicate()
    rct[2] = -10
  end repeat
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItem(#FramedText)
  rel = itemObj.getOneProp(#rel)
  rel[2] = [lst[#ID], 4]
  itemObj.setOneProp(#rel, rel)
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItem(#ButtonNote)
  itemObj.scriptInstanceList.add(me)
  setMixerMusicianInfoSheet(m_channel.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r, m_dlg, m_channel.m_loopObj_r.Instrument)
  rDlgSetTitleAndButtons(m_dlg, me, gRock.m_classManager.getObjByIDAndClass(#DlgMixerFX, #Dialog), "UOU")
  me.changeLoop(0)
  m_dlg.renderAtLoc(point(100, 100))
  if not objectp(m_channel.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r) or 1 then
    me.launchMusicianDlg()
  end if
end

on kill me
  repeat with obj in m_fxGfxObjs
    obj.kill()
  end repeat
  m_fxGfxObjs = []
  if objectp(m_protectMouseObj) then
    m_protectMouseObj = m_protectMouseObj.kill()
  end if
  if objectp(m_renderProtectMouseObj) then
    m_renderProtectMouseObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj.kill()
  end if
  if objectp(m_sndObj) then
    m_sndObj = m_sndObj.kill()
  end if
  if objectp(m_dlg) then
    m_dlg = m_dlg.kill()
  end if
  return me
end

on Report me, argObj, argWhat
  if (argObj = m_sndObj) and objectp(argObj) then
    if argWhat = #finished then
      m_renderProtectMouseObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj.kill()
      if objectp(m_sndObj) then
        m_sndObj = m_sndObj.kill()
      end if
    end if
  end if
end

on launchMusicianDlg me
  tmpInstrument = m_channel.m_loopObj_r.Instrument
  gDir.m_objDialogsMaster.openDialog(#MixerChooseMusician, [#ReportTo: me, #Instrument: tmpInstrument, #CurrentlyPlaying: m_channel.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r, #StudioMusicianIDs: gDir.m_mixerObj.m_studio_r.StudioMusicians])
end

on playPreview me
  global gDir
  m_waitingForRenderer = 0
  file = gDir.m_waveRenderer.getRendered(m_channel.m_orgFile, m_channel.m_orgFile)
  file = fileExtractName(file)
  m_sndObj = script("SoundScript").new(gDir.m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.m_soundPath & file, [#ReportTo: me, #PlayDirect: 1])
end

on mouse me, argObj, argWhat, argOption
  global gDir
  if argWhat = #click then
    if objectp(argOption) then
      if argOption.ID = #ButtonNote then
        if m_waitingForRenderer then
          exit
        end if
        m_waitingForRenderer = 1
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = script("MouseObject").new(me, rect(0, 0, 1000, 1000), [#layer: 1000000, #noPassRoll: 1, #cursorRoll: #wait])
        m_channel.channelMusicianObj.modifyLoop(m_channel.m_loopObj_r, m_channel.m_orgFile, [#PlayPerfect: 1])
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.m_doWhatWhenDoneList = [#ReportTo: me, #handler: #playPreview]
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.renderQueue()
      else
        if argOption.ID = #ButtonOK then
          if objectp(m_channel) then
            m_channel.Report(me, #Ok, m_fxObjs)
          end if
          me.kill()
        else
          if argOption.ID = #ButtonCancel then
            if m_waitingForRenderer then
              exit
            end if
            if objectp(m_channel) then
              m_channel.Report(me, #Cancel, m_fxObjs)
            end if
            me.kill()
          else
            if argOption.ID = #ArrowUp then
              me.changeLoop(-1)
            else
              if argOption.ID = #ArrowDown then
                me.changeLoop(1)
              end if
            end if
          end if
        end if
      end if
    else
      if argObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj then
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj.kill()
        if objectp(m_sndObj) then
          m_sndObj = m_sndObj.kill()
        end if
      end if
    end if
  end if
end

on changeLoop me, argDir
  global gDir
  m_channel.prepareLoop(argDir)
  loopObj_r = m_channel.m_loopObj_r
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItemByPath([#FramedText, #text])
  itemObj.setOneProp(#editData, loopObj_r.name)
end

property SP, loc, reportObj, m_musician_r, m_orgMusician_r

on new me, argReportObj, argSPNum, argLoc
  reportObj = argReportObj
  SP = sprite(argSPNum)
  loc = argLoc
  m_orgMusician_r = VOID
  return me
end

on kill me
  reportObj = 0
  m_musician_r = 0
  m_orgMusician_r = 0
  return 0
end

on Report me, argObj, argWhat
  global gDir
  if argWhat = #ClosedDlg then
    if objectp(reportObj.m_loopObj_r) then
      reportObj.prepareLoop()
      gDir.m_waveRenderer.m_doWhatWhenDoneList = [#ReportTo: reportObj.m_mixerObj, #handler: #play]
      gDir.m_waveRenderer.renderQueue()
    end if
  end if
end

on setMusician me, argObj
  m_musician_r = argObj
  if voidp(m_orgMusician_r) then
    m_orgMusician_r = argObj
  end if
  if not objectp(m_musician_r) then
    tmpFaceName = "portrait_actorEmpty_small"
  else
    if m_musician_r.className = #RealMusician then
      tmpSettings = m_musician_r.calcFaceSettings()
      tmpFaceName = "Portrait_" & m_musician_r.Gfx & "_small"
    else
      tmpFaceName = "portrait_actor00_small"
    end if
  end if
  faceMember = member(tmpFaceName)
  if faceMember.number < 1 then
    faceMember = member("portrait_actor00_small")
  end if
  SP.member = faceMember
  SP.loc = loc + point(7, 3)
end

on gotMusician me
  return objectp(m_musician_r)
end

on modifyLoop me, argLoopObj, argFile, argOptions
  global gDir
  if not objectp(m_musician_r) then
    exit
  end if
  if voidp(argOptions) then
    argOptions = [:]
  end if
  skill = rgetProp(m_musician_r, #Musicality)
  if 1 then
    rndMaxErr = 0.90000000000000002 - skill
    if rndMaxErr < 0 then
      rndMaxErr = 0.0
    end if
    rndMaxErr = 0.5 * rndMaxErr * rndMaxErr
  else
    Difficulty = getPropFromObjOrAncestor(argLoopObj, #Difficulty)
    howGood = skill - Difficulty
    if howGood > 0 then
      howGood = 0
    end if
    howGood = howGood + 1.0
    howGood = howGood * howGood
    rndMaxErr = 0.20000000000000001 * (1.0 - howGood)
  end if
  if rndMaxErr < 0.0001 then
    rndMaxErr = 0.0
  end if
  if argOptions[#PlayPerfect] = 1 then
    rndMaxErr = 0
  end if
  FX = reportObj.getEffects()
  FX.addProp(#random, [#max: rndMaxErr, #center: 0.0])
  gDir.m_waveRenderer.queueRendering(reportObj.channelNum, argFile, FX)
end

on calcMixerSettingEffectsOnResult argChannelObjs, argAlbum_r
  SongType = 0.0
  quality = 0.0
  musStyle_r = argAlbum_r.MusicStyle
  usedInst = [#Guitar: 0, #Bass: 0, #Keyboards: 0, #Vocals: 0, #Drums: 0]
  repeat with n = 1 to argChannelObjs.count
    chObj = argChannelObjs[n]
    if not objectp(chObj.m_loopObj_r) then
      next repeat
    end if
    if chObj.getSetting(#Mute) = 1 then
      next repeat
    end if
    if not objectp(chObj.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r) then
      next repeat
    end if
    vol = chObj.getSetting(#vol)
    vol = vol / 100.0
    if vol < 0.20000000000000001 then
      next repeat
    end if
    instrumentID = chObj.m_loopObj_r.Instrument
    tmp = usedInst.getaProp(instrumentID)
    if voidp(tmp) then
      tmp = 0
    end if
    usedInst.setaProp(instrumentID, tmp + 1)
  end repeat
  if (usedInst.getaProp(#Guitar) = 0) and (usedInst.getaProp(#Keyboards) = 0) and (usedInst.getaProp(#Bass) = 1) then
    SongType = SongType - 0.10000000000000001
  end if
  if (usedInst.getaProp(#Guitar) = 0) and (usedInst.getaProp(#Keyboards) = 0) and (usedInst.getaProp(#Bass) = 0) then
    SongType = SongType - 0.20000000000000001
    quality = quality - 0.29999999999999999
    musStyle_r.Metal = musStyle_r.Metal - 0.20000000000000001
    musStyle_r.rock = musStyle_r.rock - 0.10000000000000001
  end if
  if (usedInst.getaProp(#Guitar) = 0) and (usedInst.getaProp(#Keyboards) >= 1) then
    musStyle_r.Metal = musStyle_r.Metal - 0.29999999999999999
    musStyle_r.rock = musStyle_r.rock - 0.10000000000000001
  end if
  if usedInst.getaProp(#Guitar) = 2 then
    musStyle_r.Metal = musStyle_r.Metal + 0.10000000000000001
    musStyle_r.rock = musStyle_r.rock + 0.10000000000000001
  else
    if usedInst.getaProp(#Guitar) >= 3 then

global gUseful, gRock

on new me
  m_exePath = gRock.m_paths.getPath(#RockWave) & "Rockwave.exe"
  m_batchFilePath = gRock.m_paths.getPath(#RockWave)
  m_slicedPath = gRock.m_paths.getPath(#Sliced)
  m_renderToPath = gRock.m_paths.getPath(#RenderedMusic)
  m_queued = [:]
  m_rendered = [:]
  m_doWhatWhenDoneList = [:]
  m_useDll = 1
  return me
end

on kill me
  gUseful.frameTimer.deleteObject(me)
  return 0
end

on queueRendering me, argID, argFile, argSwitches
  m_queued.setaProp(argID, [#file: argFile, #Switches: argSwitches])
end

on renderQueue me
  renderStrings = []
  m_rendered = [:]
  bigRenderStr = EMPTY
  repeat with n = 1 to m_queued.count
    ID = m_queued.getPropAt(n)
    Info = m_queued[n]
    inputPath = m_slicedPath & Info[#file] & "\" & "*.*"
    if 0 then
      if isFolderEmpty(m_slicedPath & Info[#file] & "\") then
        pott("Doesn't exist", Info[#file])
        next repeat
      end if
    else
      if fileExists2(m_slicedPath & Info[#file] & ".wav") = 0 then
        pott("Doesn't exist", Info[#file])
        next repeat
      end if
    end if
    outputPath = Info[#file]
    outputPath = fileStripName(outputPath)
    outputPath = m_renderToPath & string(ID) & ".wav"
    tmpFileObj = xtra("FileIO").new()
    tmpFileObj.openFile(outputPath, 0)
    if tmpFileObj.status() = 0 then
      delete tmpFileObj
      tmpFileObj.closeFile()
    end if
    tmpInfo = Info[#Switches].duplicate()
    tmpInfo[#in] = inputPath
    tmpInfo[#Out] = outputPath
    if m_useDll then
      renderStr = mixGenFXStr(tmpInfo, #dll)
      renderStrings.add(renderStr)
    else
      renderStr = mixGenFXStr(tmpInfo, #Exe)
      off = offset(inputPath, renderStr)
      renderStr = renderStr.char[off..renderStr.length]
      bigRenderStr = bigRenderStr & renderStr & RETURN & numToChar(10)
    end if
    m_rendered.setaProp(ID, outputPath)
  end repeat
  if m_useDll then
    if renderStrings.count = 0 then
      exit
    end if
    mixCallRockWave(renderStrings)
  else
    if m_queued.count = 0 then
      open(m_exePath && bigRenderStr.line[1])
    else
      batchFile = m_batchFilePath & "batch.txt"
      writeFile(batchFile, bigRenderStr)
      open(m_exePath && "/batch:" & batchFile)
    end if
  end if
  m_queued = [:]
  if m_useDll then
    if m_doWhatWhenDoneList.count then
      m_maxWait = the milliSeconds + integer(10.0 * 1000)
      m_waitUntilMsecs = the milliSeconds + 0
      gUseful.frameTimer.addObject(me)
    end if
  else
    if m_doWhatWhenDoneList.count then
      m_waitUntilMsecs = the milliSeconds + 500
      gUseful.frameTimer.addObject(me)
    end if
  end if
end

on getRendered me, argID, argAltFileName
  tmp = m_rendered.getaProp(argID)
  if voidp(tmp) then
    return argAltFileName
  end if
  return tmp
end

on timeTick me
  if the milliSeconds > m_waitUntilMsecs then
    tmpImDone = 1
    tmpFileObj = xtra("FileIO").new()
    repeat with n = m_rendered.count() down to 1
      tmpFileObj.openFile(m_rendered[n], 0)
      if tmpFileObj.status() = 0 then
        tmpFileObj.closeFile()
        next repeat
      end if
      tmpImDone = 0
      exit repeat
    end repeat
    if tmpImDone = 0 then
      if the milliSeconds > m_maxWait then
      else
        m_waitUntilMsecs = the milliSeconds + 500
        exit
      end if
    end if
    if objectp(m_doWhatWhenDoneList[#ReportTo]) then
      tmpHandler = m_doWhatWhenDoneList[#handler]
      if voidp(tmpHandler) then
        tmpHandler = #Report
      end if
      if m_doWhatWhenDoneList[#ReportTo].handler(tmpHandler) then
        call(tmpHandler, m_doWhatWhenDoneList[#ReportTo])
      end if
    end if
    gUseful.frameTimer.deleteObject(me)
  end if
end

    lst = tmpInstrumentsWithMixSetting.getaProp(loop_r.Instrument)
    if not listp(lst) then
      lst = []
      tmpInstrumentsWithMixSetting.addProp(loop_r.Instrument, lst)
    end if
    lst.add(channel_r)
  end repeat
  tmpUnusedLoopsByInstrument = sortedByInstrument.duplicate()
  importance = [:]
  importance.sort()
  unusedMusicians = []
  musiciansMix = [:]
  repeat with mus_r in bandMemberObjs
    lst = tmpInstrumentsWithMixSetting.getaProp(mus_r.NowPlaying)

    if lst.count then
      channel_r = lst[1]
      tmpImportance = channelInfoObjs.getPos(channel_r)
      importance.addProp(tmpImportance, mus_r)
      musiciansMix.addProp(mus_r, channel_r)
      lst.deleteAt(1)
      tmpLoops = tmpUnusedLoopsByInstrument.getaProp(mus_r.NowPlaying)
      loop_r = gRock.m_classManager.getObjByIDAndClass(channel_r.LoopID, #loop)
      tmpLoops.deleteOne(loop_r)
      next repeat
    end if
    unusedMusicians.add(mus_r)
  end repeat
  repeat with n = 1 to importance.count
    mus_r = importance[n]
    channel_r = musiciansMix.getaProp(mus_r)

  end repeat
  repeat with mus_r in unusedMusicians
    tmpLoops = tmpUnusedLoopsByInstrument.getaProp(mus_r.NowPlaying)
    if voidp(tmpLoops) then
      tmpLoops = []
    end if
    if tmpLoops.count then
      loop_r = tmpLoops[1]
      tmpLoops.deleteAt(1)
    else
      loop_r = sortedByInstrument.getaProp(mus_r.NowPlaying)[1]
    end if
    perChannelSettings.add([#Musician: mus_r, #loop: loop_r])
  end repeat
  repeat with n = perChannelSettings.count down to m_studio_r.NumChannels + 1
    perChannelSettings.deleteAt(n)
  end repeat
  repeat with n = perChannelSettings.count + 1 to m_studio_r.NumChannels
    perChannelSettings.add([#Musician: 0, #loop: 0])
  end repeat
  repeat with n = channelInfoObjs.count + 1 to m_studio_r.NumChannels

  internalChannelOrder = [#Drums, #Bass, #Guitar, #Keyboards, #Vocals]
  sortedByInternal = [:]

  repeat with visualChNr = 1 to perChannelSettings.count
    Info = perChannelSettings[visualChNr]
    if objectp(Info[#loop]) then
      sortedByInternal.addProp(internalChannelOrder.getPos(Info[#loop].Instrument), visualChNr)

    end if

  repeat with n = 1 to sortedByInternal.count

    Info = perChannelSettings[visualChNr]

  end repeat
  m_musiciansPlaying = [:]
  channelObjs = []
  prioSortedChannelObjs = [:]
  tmpSPNum = gDir.m_spriteList[#channels]
  repeat with visualChNr = 1 to m_studio_r.NumChannels
    infoList = perChannelSettings[visualChNr]

on calcAlbumSettings me
  album_r = gRock.m_classManager.createObj(#album)
  album_r.ID = gRock.m_classManager.genUniqueID(album_r)
  band_r = gRock.m_context.getFocus(#Band)
  band_r.calcStyleMix()
  gRock.m_classManager.copy(m_song_r.StyleMix, album_r.MusicStyle)
  album_r.SongType = m_song_r.SongType
  numUsedChannels = 0
  qualityList = [:]
  repeat with n = 1 to channelObjs.count()
    chObj = channelObjs[n]
    if not objectp(chObj.m_loopObj_r) then
      next repeat
    end if
    if chObj.getSetting(#Mute) = 1 then
      next repeat
    end if
    if not objectp(chObj.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r) then
      next repeat
    end if
    vol = chObj.getSetting(#vol)
    vol = vol / 100.0
    if vol > 0.29999999999999999 then
      weight = 1.0
    else
      weight = vol / 0.29999999999999999
    end if
    if vol > 0 then
      numUsedChannels = numUsedChannels + 1
    end if
    instrumentID = chObj.m_loopObj_r.Instrument
    if instrumentID = #Vocals then
      weight = weight * 1.30000000000000004
    end if
    Musicality = rgetProp(chObj.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r, #Musicality)
    if objectp(Musicality) then
      Musicality = Musicality.Current
    end if
    qualityList.addProp(weight, Musicality)
    tmpStyleMix = rCreateCopy(chObj.m_loopObj_r.StyleMix)
    gRock.m_classManager.multiply(tmpStyleMix, weight)
    gRock.m_classManager.add(album_r.MusicStyle, tmpStyleMix)
  end repeat
  tuneDebug("ChannelsQuality", qualityList)
  channelsQuality = calcAverage(qualityList)
  calcMixerSettingEffectsOnResult(channelObjs, album_r)
  musician_r = band_r.getMusicianPlaying(#Vocals)
  if objectp(musician_r) then
    rCalcObjsAverage(album_r.MusicStyle, [1.0: album_r.MusicStyle, 0.20000000000000001: musician_r.MusicStyle])
  end if
  numUsedChannelsQualityChangeList = [-0.29999999999999999, -0.20000000000000001, -0.10000000000000001, 0.0, 0, 1, 0.14999999999999999, 0.20000000000000001]
  if numUsedChannels > numUsedChannelsQualityChangeList.count then
    numChQualityChange = numUsedChannelsQualityChangeList[numUsedChannelsQualityChangeList.count]
  else
    numChQualityChange = numUsedChannelsQualityChangeList[numUsedChannels]
  end if
  album_r.quality = numChQualityChange + calcAverage([0.25: m_song_r.quality, 1: channelsQuality, 0.25: m_studio_r.quality])
  if album_r.quality < 0 then
    album_r.quality = 0
  else
    if album_r.quality > 1 then
      album_r.quality = 1
    end if
  end if
  tmpProps = gRock.m_classManager.getPropsInClass(album_r.MusicStyle.className)
  repeat with propNr = 1 to tmpProps.count
    prop = tmpProps.getPropAt(propNr)
    val = rgetProp(album_r.MusicStyle, prop)
    if val < 0 then
      rsetPropSimple(album_r.MusicStyle, prop, 0)
      next repeat
    end if
    if val > 1 then
      rsetPropSimple(album_r.MusicStyle, prop, 1)
    end if
  end repeat
  rCalcObjsAverage(album_r.ImageStyle, [1.0: band_r.MusicStyle])
  tuneDebug("Quality: Song", m_song_r.quality, "Channels", channelsQuality, "Studio", m_studio_r.quality, "NumChannels:", numChQualityChange, "Total", album_r.quality)
  tuneDebugObject(album_r.MusicStyle, "MusicStyle")
  tuneDebug("SongType", album_r.SongType)
  album_r.recorded(m_song_r)
end

on calcMusiciansReactions me
  band_r = gRock.m_context.getFocus(#Band)
  musicians_r = []
  repeat with n = 1 to band_r.members.count
    musID = band_r.members[n]
    musician_r = gRock.m_classManager.getObjByIDAndClass(musID, #RealMusician)
    musicians_r.add(musician_r)
  end repeat
  whoNormallyPlaysInstrument = [:]
  repeat with n = 1 to musicians_r.count
    musician_r = musicians_r[n]
    othersPlayingThat = whoNormallyPlaysInstrument.getaProp(musician_r.NowPlaying)
    if voidp(othersPlayingThat) then
      othersPlayingThat = []
      whoNormallyPlaysInstrument.setaProp(musician_r.NowPlaying, othersPlayingThat)
    end if
    othersPlayingThat.add(musician_r)
  end repeat
  volPerMusician = [:]
  bandTotalVol = 0.0
  repeat with n = 1 to channelObjs.count()
    chObj = channelObjs[n]
    if not objectp(chObj.m_loopObj_r) then
      next repeat
    end if
    if chObj.getSetting(#Mute) = 1 then
      next repeat
    end if
    if chObj.getSetting(#vol) = 0 then
      next repeat
    end if
    if not objectp(chObj.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r) then
      next repeat
    end if
    vol = chObj.getSetting(#vol)
    whosPlaying_r = chObj.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r
    Instrument = chObj.m_loopObj_r.Instrument
    if whosPlaying_r.className = #StudioMusician then
      if 0 then
        normallyPlays = whoNormallyPlaysInstrument.getaProp(Instrument)
        if listp(normallyPlays) then
          repeat with musician_r in normallyPlays
            angryFact = -0.20000000000000001 * (whosPlaying_r.Selfperception + 1) / 2
            rCreateModifier(#StudioMusician, musician_r.ID, #Mood, angryFact, 10)
            pott("Studiomusician is playing my instrument!", musician_r.ID)
          end repeat
        end if
      end if
      next repeat
    end if
    totVol = volPerMusician.getaProp(whosPlaying_r)
    if voidp(totVol) then
      totVol = 0.0
    end if
    totVol = totVol + vol
    volPerMusician.setaProp(whosPlaying_r, totVol)
    bandTotalVol = bandTotalVol + vol
  end repeat
  repeat with musician_r in musicians_r
    if voidp(volPerMusician.getaProp(musician_r)) then
      volPerMusician.addProp(musician_r, 0)
    end if
  end repeat
  if volPerMusician.count = 0 then
  else
    averageVol = bandTotalVol / volPerMusician.count
    angriestVolMusician_r = 0
    worstVolFraction = 1
    repeat with musician_r in musicians_r
      angryThreshold = (0.34999999999999998 * (musician_r.Selfperception + 1)) + 0.10000000000000001
      volFraction = volPerMusician.getaProp(musician_r) / averageVol
      pott("Angry?", musician_r.ID, angryThreshold, volFraction, volPerMusician.getaProp(musician_r), averageVol)
      if volFraction < angryThreshold then
        tmp = volFraction / angryThreshold
        if tmp < worstVolFraction then
          worstVolFraction = tmp
          angriestVolMusician_r = musician_r
        end if
      end if
    end repeat
    if objectp(angriestVolMusician_r) then
      angryFact = 0.20000000000000001
      rCreateModifier(#StudioLowVol, angriestVolMusician_r.ID, #Mood, angryFact, 10)
      pott("Angry card", angriestVolMusician_r.ID)
      gRock.m_eventCardsManager.tryNewShowEventCard(#ECOCArtistLow, [#EventCardOptions: [#HumanID: angriestVolMusician_r.ID]])
    end if
  end if
end

  m_settings = [#vol: 0, #Pan: 0, #Mute: 0]
  return me
end

on kill me
  if objectp(envelopeObj) then
    envelopeObj = envelopeObj.kill()
  end if
  if objectp(m_changeInstrumentObj) then
    m_changeInstrumentObj = m_changeInstrumentObj.kill()
  end if
  if objectp(m_track) then
    m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.deleteTrack(m_track)
    m_track = m_track.kill()
  end if
  channelMusicianObj = channelMusicianObj.kill()
  repeat with tmpObj in controllerObjs
    tmpObj.kill()
  end repeat
  controllerObjs = [:]
  return 0

on getNumSPs me
  return numUsedSPs
end

on mouse me, argObj, argWhat
  if argWhat = #down then
    case argObj.ID of
      #Mute:
        if me.getSetting(#Mute) > 0 then
          me.setSetting(#Mute, 0)
        else
          me.setSetting(#Mute, 1)
        end if
      #FX:
        me.openSettings()
      #Instrument:
        me.openSettings()
    end case
  end if
end

on openSettings me
  m_mixerObj.stop()
  if channelMusicianObj.gotMusician() = 0 then
    gDir.m_objDialogsMaster.openDialog(#MixerChooseMusician, [#ReportTo: me, #Instrument: VOID, #CurrentlyPlaying: VOID, #StudioMusicianIDs: m_mixerObj.m_studio_r.StudioMusicians])
  else
    obj = gDir.m_objDialogsMaster.openDialog(#MixerFX, [#channelObj: me, #FXObjs: m_fxObjs])
    obj.init()
  end if
end

on Report me, argObj, argWhat, argOptions
  tmpPos = controllerObjs.getPos(argObj)
  if tmpPos then
    tmpID = controllerObjs.getPropAt(tmpPos)
    case tmpID of
      #volume:
        argOptions = 100 - integer(100 * argOptions)
        me.setSetting(#vol, argOptions)
      #Frequency:
        me.setSetting(#freq, argOptions)
      #Pan:
        if argWhat = #changed then
          me.setSetting(#Pan, argOptions)
        end if
    end case
  else
    if argWhat = #ClosedFX then
      gDir.m_waveRenderer.m_doWhatWhenDoneList = [#ReportTo: m_mixerObj, #handler: #playSoon]
      gDir.m_waveRenderer.renderQueue()
    else
      if argWhat = #ChoseMusician then
        channelMusicianObj.setMusician(argOptions[#Musician])
        tmpLst = m_mixerObj.getLoops(argOptions[#Instrument])
        tmpOKLoop_r = tmpLst[1]
        tmpLst = tmpLst.duplicate()
        repeat with obj in m_mixerObj.channelObjs
          if objectp(obj.m_loopObj_r) then
            tmpLst.deleteOne(obj.m_loopObj_r)
          end if
        end repeat
        if tmpLst.count then
          tmpOKLoop_r = tmpLst[1]
        end if
        me.prepareLoop(tmpOKLoop_r)
        if m_settings[#vol] = 0 then
          me.setSetting(#vol, 70, #Gfx)
        end if
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.m_doWhatWhenDoneList = [#ReportTo: m_mixerObj, #handler: #playSoon]
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.renderQueue()
      end if
    end if
  end if
end

on prepareLoop me, argLoopObj
  if argLoopObj = #next then
    argLoopObj = 1
  end if
  if integerp(argLoopObj) then
    if not objectp(m_loopObj_r) then
      exit
    end if
    tmpLst = m_mixerObj.getLoops(m_loopObj_r.Instrument)
    tmpPos = tmpLst.getPos(m_loopObj_r)
    tmpPos = tmpPos + argLoopObj
    if tmpPos > tmpLst.count then
      tmpPos = tmpLst.count
    else
      if tmpPos < 1 then
        tmpPos = 1
      end if
    end if
    argLoopObj = tmpLst[tmpPos]
  else
    if voidp(argLoopObj) or (argLoopObj = #Current) then
      if objectp(m_loopObj_r) then
        argLoopObj = m_loopObj_r
      end if
    end if
  end if
  m_loopObj_r = argLoopObj
  if objectp(m_loopObj_r) then
    ID = m_loopObj_r.Instrument
    instObj = gRock.m_classManager.getObjByID(ID)
  end if
  if objectp(instObj) then
    instMembName = instObj.Gfx & "02"
  else
    instMembName = "icon_cancel01"
  end if
  m_SPInstrument.member = instMembName
  if not objectp(m_loopObj_r) then
    exit
  end if
  m_orgFile = me.fixPossibleVocalFileName(m_loopObj_r)
  if objectp(m_track) then
    m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.deleteTrack(m_track)
    m_track = m_track.kill()
  end if
  if channelMusicianObj.gotMusician() = 0 then
    exit
  end if
  isPlaying = 0
  LoopType = rgetProp(m_loopObj_r, #LoopType)
  if LoopType = #MIDI then
    m_track = script("TrackScript").new(m_mixerObj.m_sequencer)
    m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.addTrack(m_track)
  else
    channelMusicianObj.modifyLoop(m_loopObj_r, m_orgFile)
    m_track = script("TrackLoopScript").new(m_mixerObj.m_sequencer)
    m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.addLoopTrack(m_track)
  end if
  m_isLoaded = 0
end

on fixPossibleVocalFileName me, argLoopObj
  if argLoopObj.Instrument = #Vocals then
    if offset("All", argLoopObj.file) then
      return argLoopObj.file
    end if
    tmpMus_r = channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r
    if objectp(tmpMus_r) then
      if tmpMus_r.className = #RealMusician then
        tmpSingerSuffix = tmpMus_r.getSoundFilePrefix()
      end if
    end if
    if not stringp(tmpSingerSuffix) then
      pott("Can't sing!")
      tmpSingerSuffix = "a01"
    end if
    return argLoopObj.file & tmpSingerSuffix
  end if
  return argLoopObj.file
end

on play me
  global gDir
  if m_isLoaded = 1 then
    exit
  end if
  if not objectp(m_loopObj_r) then
    exit
  end if
  if not objectp(m_track) then
    exit
  end if
  LoopType = rgetProp(m_loopObj_r, #LoopType)
  if LoopType = #MIDI then
    m_track.load(member("TrkSq" & m_orgFile).text.value, 2)
  else
    m_renderedFile = gDir.m_waveRenderer.getRendered(channelNum, m_orgFile)
    m_renderedFile = fileExtractName(m_renderedFile)
    m_track.setSetting(#file, m_renderedFile)
    repeat with n = 1 to m_settings.count
      me.setSetting(m_settings.getPropAt(n), m_settings[n])
    end repeat
  end if
  m_isLoaded = 1
end

on stop me
  isPlaying = 0
end

on atEnd me
  return 0
end

on setSetting me, argProp, argVal, argChangeGfx
  if not voidp(argVal) then
    m_settings[argProp] = argVal
  end if
  if argProp = #vol then
    if argChangeGfx = #Gfx then
      tmpObj = controllerObjs[#volume]
      tmpObj.setFactor(argVal / 100.0)
    end if
    if voidp(argVal) then
      argVal = me.getSetting(#vol)
    end if
    argVal = argVal * m_mixerObj.m_masterVolFact
    if objectp(m_track) then
      m_track.setSetting(#vol, integer(argVal))
    end if
  else
    if argProp = #Pan then
      if argChangeGfx = #Gfx then
        tmpObj = controllerObjs[#Pan]
        tmpObj.setMinMaxRelVal(argVal)
      end if
      if objectp(m_track) then
        m_track.setSetting(#Pan, argVal)
      end if
    else
      if argProp = #freq then
        if floatp(argVal) then
          argVal = argVal * 2
          if abs(argVal - 1.0) < 0.05 then
            argVal = 1.0
          end if
        else
        end if
      else
        if argProp = #Mute then
          if objectp(m_track) then
            m_track.setSetting(#Mute, argVal)
          end if
        end if
      end if
    end if
  end if
end

on getSetting me, argProp
  return m_settings[argProp]
end

on getEffects me, argLoop_r
  if voidp(argLoop_r) then
    argLoop_r = m_loopObj_r
  end if
  if not objectp(argLoop_r) then
    exit
  end if
  tmp = me.calcLoopRenderTempo(argLoop_r)
  repeat with n = 1 to m_fxObjs.count
    ID = m_fxObjs.getPropAt(n)
    obj = m_fxObjs[n]
    if ilk(obj) = #instance then
      lst = obj.getSettings()
      if lst[#Active] then
        tmp.setaProp(obj.m_fxName, lst)
      end if
      next repeat
    end if
    if obj[#Active] = 1 then
      tmp.setaProp(ID, obj)
    end if
  end repeat
  return tmp
end

on calcLoopRenderTempo me, argLoop_r
  TimeSig = m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.m_beatSignature
  timeStr = string(TimeSig[1]) & "/" & string(TimeSig[2])
  tmpBPM = float(m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.m_bpm)
  if not (argLoop_r.BPM > 0) then
    argLoop_r.BPM = 120
  end if
  if (tmpBPM / argLoop_r.BPM) < 0.80000000000000004 then
    tmpBPM = tmpBPM * 2
  end if
  return [#tempo: [#BPM: tmpBPM, #Bars: argLoop_r.numBars, #TimeSig: timeStr]]
end

on getMixDownParams me
  if not objectp(m_loopObj_r) then
    return 0
  end if
  if not stringp(m_renderedFile) then
    return 0
  end if
  if m_renderedFile.length = 0 then
    return 0
  end if
  if me.getSetting(#Mute) = 1 then
    return 0
  end if
  tmpFullPath = gRock.m_paths.getPath(#RenderedMusic) & m_renderedFile
  return [#file: tmpFullPath, #vol: me.getSetting(#vol) / 100.0]
end

on setMusician me, argObj
  channelMusicianObj.setMusician(argObj)
end

        m_waitingForRenderer = 1
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = script("MouseObject").new(me, rect(0, 0, 1000, 1000), [#layer: 1000000, #noPassRoll: 1, #cursorRoll: #wait])
        FX = m_channel.getEffects(m_loop_r)

        gDir.m_waveRenderer.renderQueue()
      else
        if argOption.ID = #ButtonCancel then
          m_channel.prepareLoop(m_loop_r)
          m_channel.Report(me, #ClosedFX)
          me.kill()
        else
          if argOption.ID = #Pic then
            me.launchMusicianDlg()
          else
            if argOption.ID = #ArrowUp then
              me.changeLoop(-1)
            else
              if argOption.ID = #ArrowDown then

              end if
            end if
          end if
        end if
      end if
    else
      if argObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj then
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj.kill()

      m_instrument = argOption[#Instrument]
      m_channel.channelMusicianObj.setMusician(musician_r)
      me.changeLoop(0)
      me.setMusician(musician_r)
    end if
  end if
end

on launchMusicianDlg me
  gDir.m_objDialogsMaster.openDialog(#MixerChooseMusician, [#ReportTo: me, #Instrument: m_instrument, #CurrentlyPlaying: m_channel.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r, #StudioMusicianIDs: gDir.m_mixerObj.m_studio_r.StudioMusicians])
end

on playPreview me
  global gDir
  m_waitingForRenderer = 0
  file = gDir.m_waveRenderer.getRendered("preview", m_CPFile)
  file = fileExtractName(file)
  m_sndObj = script("SoundScript").new(gDir.m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.m_soundPath & file, [#ReportTo: me, #PlayDirect: 1])
end

on mouse me, argObj, argWhat, argOption
  if argWhat = #click then
    if objectp(argOption) then
      if argOption.ID = #ButtonOK then
        if m_waitingForRenderer then
          exit
        end if
        m_waitingForRenderer = 1
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = script("MouseObject").new(me, rect(0, 0, 1000, 1000), [#layer: 1000000, #noPassRoll: 1, #cursorRoll: #wait])
        FX = m_channel.getEffects(m_loop_r)
        m_CPFile = m_channel.fixPossibleVocalFileName(m_loop_r)
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.queueRendering("preview", m_CPFile, FX)
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.m_doWhatWhenDoneList = [#ReportTo: me, #handler: #playPreview]
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.renderQueue()
      else
        if argOption.ID = #ButtonCancel then
          m_channel.prepareLoop(m_loop_r)
          m_channel.Report(me, #ClosedFX)
          me.kill()
        else
          if argOption.ID = #Pic then
            me.launchMusicianDlg()
          else
            if argOption.ID = #ArrowUp then
              me.changeLoop(-1)
            else
              if argOption.ID = #ArrowDown then
                me.changeLoop(1)
              end if
            end if
          end if
        end if
      end if
    else
      if argObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj then
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj.kill()
        if objectp(m_sndObj) then
          m_sndObj = m_sndObj.kill()
        end if
      end if
    end if
  end if
end

on changeLoop me, argDir
  tmpLst = gDir.m_mixerObj.getLoops(m_instrument)
  if listp(tmpLst) then
    tmpPos = tmpLst.getPos(m_loop_r)
    tmpPos = tmpPos + argDir
    if tmpPos > tmpLst.count then
      tmpPos = tmpLst.count
    else
      if tmpPos < 1 then
        tmpPos = 1
      end if
    end if
    m_loop_r = tmpLst[tmpPos]
  else
    m_loop_r = 0
  end if
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItemByPath([#Chooser, #text])
  if objectp(m_loop_r) then
    itemObj.setOneProp(#editData, m_loop_r.name)
  else
    itemObj.setOneProp(#editData, EMPTY)
  end if
end

property m_mixerObj, m_spriteList, m_startedHere, m_CP, m_waveRenderer, m_objDialogsMaster, m_interfaceBar, m_dlgOKButton, m_waitForECObj, m_progressObj
global gUseful, gRock

on new me
  set the mouseUpScript to "VirtualMouseUp"
  set the mouseDownScript to "VirtualMouseDown"
  set the keyUpScript to "VirtualKeyUp"
  set the keyDownScript to "VirtualKeyDown"
  m_spriteList = member("SpriteList").text.value
  if not listp(m_spriteList) then
    m_spriteList = [#InterfaceBarSpriteList: [#BandMemberIcons: 6, #BG: 11, #Rehearsal: 12, #MoneyText: 13, #MoneyVal: 14, #DateText: 15, #DateVal: 16, #CredMeter: 17, #MainMenu: 18], #MasterVol: 26, #ButtonPlay: 27, #ButtonStop: 28, #StudioPic: 29, #ButtonOK: 31, #channels: 40, #Dialogs: 101, #FX: 133, #Watcher: 136, #Console: 138, #Diagram: 140]
  end if
  return me
end

on init me
  global gRock
  gUseful.setSoundSystem(#xtra)
  gUseful.soundObj.soundPath = gRock.m_paths.getPath(#sound)
  m_interfaceBar = script("InterfaceBarScript").new(0)
  m_interfaceBar.init()
  m_interfaceBar.redrawAfterLoad()
  m_objDialogsMaster = script("DialogsMasterScript").new(m_spriteList[#Dialogs])
  m_startedHere = not objectp(gRock.m_context.getFocus(#Studio))
  m_waveRenderer = script("WaveRenderScript").new()
  m_mixerObj = script("MixerScript").new()
  gRock.m_context.setContext(#Mixer)
  gRock.m_gameTimer.activate(0)
  m_dlgOKButton = script("DlgMixerScript").new()
  gRock.m_eventCardsManager.allowEventCardsWithProp(#ShowInMixer, 0, 1)
  gRock.m_msgManager.msg(#EnterMixer)
  m_waitForECObj = script("WaitForEventCardsScript").new(0, 0, [#object: me, #handler: #startMixer])
end

on startMovie me
end

on startMixer me
  m_mixerObj.prepareFirstTimePlay()
  if objectp(m_waitForECObj) then
    m_waitForECObj = m_waitForECObj.kill()
  end if
end

on kill me
  global gRock
  if objectp(m_waitForECObj) then
    m_waitForECObj = m_waitForECObj.kill()
  end if
  if objectp(m_dlgOKButton) then
    m_dlgOKButton = m_dlgOKButton.kill()
  end if
  m_interfaceBar = m_interfaceBar.kill()
  m_waveRenderer.deleteDecodedFiles()
  m_waveRenderer = m_waveRenderer.kill()
  if objectp(m_CP) then
    m_CP = m_CP.kill()
  end if
  m_mixerObj = m_mixerObj.kill()
  gRock.m_eventCardsManager.allowEventCardsWithProp(#ShowInMixer, 0, 0)
  gRock.m_msgManager.msg(#leavemixer)
  m_objDialogsMaster = m_objDialogsMaster.kill()
  if objectp(m_progressObj) then
    m_progressObj = m_progressObj.kill()
  end if
  gUseful.setSoundSystem(#Director)
end

on progressInit me, argNumFiles
  if objectp(m_progressObj) then
    m_progressObj = m_progressObj.kill()
  end if
  if argNumFiles < 2 then
    exit
  end if
  m_progressObj = script("FakeDlgProgressBarScript").new(VOID, argNumFiles)
end

on progressReport me, arg
  if objectp(m_progressObj) then
    m_progressObj.progressReport()
    if m_progressObj.m_partDone = 1 then
      m_progressObj = m_progressObj.kill()
    end if
  end if
end

property m_dlg, m_fxGfxObjs, m_fxObjs, m_channel, m_sndObj, m_protectMouseObj, m_renderProtectMouseObj, m_waitingForRenderer
global gDir, gRock

on new me, argChannelObj, argFXObjs
  m_channel = argChannelObj
  m_fxObjs = argFXObjs
  if not listp(m_fxObjs) then
    m_fxObjs = [:]
  end if
  if m_fxObjs.count = 0 then
    studio_r = gRock.m_context.getFocus(#Studio)
    repeat with FXID in studio_r.AvailableFX
      scriptName = string(FXID) & "Script"
      if member(scriptName).number > 0 then
        m_fxObjs.addProp(FXID, script(scriptName).new())
        next repeat
      end if
      pott("FX undefined", FXID)
    end repeat
  end if
  m_dlg = script("Dialog").new([#AttachImageToMember: #temp, #StartSpriteNum: gDir.m_spriteList[#FX], #NumSprites: 2, #OKtoResize: 1])
  sprite(gDir.m_spriteList[#FX]).ink = 8

  m_dlg.rawCreate(lst)

    obj.setOneProp(#rel, [0, 0, [#ZYXSrnd, 3], [#ZYXSrnd, 4]])

  end if
  obj = m_dlg.getItem(#close)

  end if

  m_waitingForRenderer = 0
  return me
end

on init me
  m_fxGfxObjs = []
  lastRel = [#FramedText, 4]
  extraSpace = 20
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItem(#FXDummy)
  itemObj.setOneProp(#Pic, "Dummy")
  rct = itemObj.getOneProp(#inOffsetRect).duplicate()
  rel = itemObj.getOneProp(#rel).duplicate()
  pott(rct)
  repeat with n = 1 to m_fxObjs.count
    fxObj = m_fxObjs[n]
    fxType = m_fxObjs.getPropAt(n)
    obj = script("FXGfxScript").new(me, fxType, fxObj)
    lst = [#ID: symbol("FX" & string(n)), #type: #Dialog, #inOffsetRect: rct, #rel: rel, #dialogDataMemberName: "DlgSimpleData", #ch: n + 1, #usingMouse: 0]
    newObj = m_dlg.addItem(lst)
    newObj.attachDlg(obj.m_dlg)
    m_fxGfxObjs.add(obj)
    rel = rel.duplicate()
    rel[2] = [lst[#ID], 4]
    rct = rct.duplicate()
    rct[2] = -10
  end repeat

  rel = itemObj.getOneProp(#rel)
  rel[2] = [lst[#ID], 4]
  itemObj.setOneProp(#rel, rel)
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItem(#ButtonNote)
  itemObj.scriptInstanceList.add(me)

  rDlgSetTitleAndButtons(m_dlg, me, gRock.m_classManager.getObjByIDAndClass(#DlgMixerFX, #Dialog), "UOU")
  me.changeLoop(0)
  m_dlg.renderAtLoc(point(100, 100))

    me.launchMusicianDlg()
  end if
end

on kill me
  repeat with obj in m_fxGfxObjs
    obj.kill()
  end repeat
  m_fxGfxObjs = []
  if objectp(m_protectMouseObj) then
    m_protectMouseObj = m_protectMouseObj.kill()
  end if
  if objectp(m_renderProtectMouseObj) then
    m_renderProtectMouseObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj.kill()
  end if
  if objectp(m_sndObj) then
    m_sndObj = m_sndObj.kill()
  end if
  if objectp(m_dlg) then
    m_dlg = m_dlg.kill()
  end if
  return me
end

on Report me, argObj, argWhat
  if (argObj = m_sndObj) and objectp(argObj) then
    if argWhat = #finished then
      m_renderProtectMouseObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj.kill()
      if objectp(m_sndObj) then
        m_sndObj = m_sndObj.kill()
      end if
    end if
  end if
end

on launchMusicianDlg me
  tmpInstrument = m_channel.m_loopObj_r.Instrument
  gDir.m_objDialogsMaster.openDialog(#MixerChooseMusician, [#ReportTo: me, #Instrument: tmpInstrument, #CurrentlyPlaying: m_channel.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r, #StudioMusicianIDs: gDir.m_mixerObj.m_studio_r.StudioMusicians])
end

on playPreview me
  global gDir
  m_waitingForRenderer = 0
  file = gDir.m_waveRenderer.getRendered(m_channel.m_orgFile, m_channel.m_orgFile)
  file = fileExtractName(file)
  m_sndObj = script("SoundScript").new(gDir.m_mixerObj.m_sequencer.m_soundPath & file, [#ReportTo: me, #PlayDirect: 1])
end

on mouse me, argObj, argWhat, argOption
  global gDir
  if argWhat = #click then
    if objectp(argOption) then
      if argOption.ID = #ButtonNote then
        if m_waitingForRenderer then
          exit
        end if
        m_waitingForRenderer = 1
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = script("MouseObject").new(me, rect(0, 0, 1000, 1000), [#layer: 1000000, #noPassRoll: 1, #cursorRoll: #wait])
        m_channel.channelMusicianObj.modifyLoop(m_channel.m_loopObj_r, m_channel.m_orgFile, [#PlayPerfect: 1])
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.m_doWhatWhenDoneList = [#ReportTo: me, #handler: #playPreview]
        gDir.m_waveRenderer.renderQueue()
      else
        if argOption.ID = #ButtonOK then
          if objectp(m_channel) then
            m_channel.Report(me, #Ok, m_fxObjs)
          end if
          me.kill()
        else
          if argOption.ID = #ButtonCancel then
            if m_waitingForRenderer then
              exit
            end if
            if objectp(m_channel) then
              m_channel.Report(me, #Cancel, m_fxObjs)
            end if
            me.kill()
          else
            if argOption.ID = #ArrowUp then
              me.changeLoop(-1)
            else
              if argOption.ID = #ArrowDown then
                me.changeLoop(1)
              end if
            end if
          end if
        end if
      end if
    else
      if argObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj then
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = m_renderProtectMouseObj.kill()
        if objectp(m_sndObj) then
          m_sndObj = m_sndObj.kill()
        end if
      end if
    end if
  end if
end

on changeLoop me, argDir
  global gDir
  m_channel.prepareLoop(argDir)
  loopObj_r = m_channel.m_loopObj_r
  itemObj = m_dlg.getItemByPath([#FramedText, #text])
  itemObj.setOneProp(#editData, loopObj_r.name)
end

on setMusician me, argObj
  m_musician_r = argObj
  if voidp(m_orgMusician_r) then

  end if

    tmpFaceName = "portrait_actorEmpty_small"
  else
    if m_musician_r.className = #RealMusician then
      tmpSettings = m_musician_r.calcFaceSettings()
      tmpFaceName = "Portrait_" & m_musician_r.Gfx & "_small"
    else
      tmpFaceName = "portrait_actor00_small"
    end if

on modifyLoop me, argLoopObj, argFile, argOptions
  global gDir
  if not objectp(m_musician_r) then
    exit
  end if
  if voidp(argOptions) then
    argOptions = [:]
  end if
  skill = rgetProp(m_musician_r, #Musicality)
  if 1 then
    rndMaxErr = 0.90000000000000002 - skill
    if rndMaxErr < 0 then
      rndMaxErr = 0.0
    end if
    rndMaxErr = 0.5 * rndMaxErr * rndMaxErr
  else
    Difficulty = getPropFromObjOrAncestor(argLoopObj, #Difficulty)
    howGood = skill - Difficulty
    if howGood > 0 then
      howGood = 0
    end if
    howGood = howGood + 1.0
    howGood = howGood * howGood
    rndMaxErr = 0.20000000000000001 * (1.0 - howGood)
  end if
  if rndMaxErr < 0.0001 then
    rndMaxErr = 0.0
  end if
  if argOptions[#PlayPerfect] = 1 then
    rndMaxErr = 0
  end if
  FX = reportObj.getEffects()
  FX.addProp(#random, [#max: rndMaxErr, #center: 0.0])
  gDir.m_waveRenderer.queueRendering(reportObj.channelNum, argFile, FX)
end

on calcMixerSettingEffectsOnResult argChannelObjs, argAlbum_r
  SongType = 0.0
  quality = 0.0
  musStyle_r = argAlbum_r.MusicStyle
  usedInst = [#Guitar: 0, #Bass: 0, #Keyboards: 0, #Vocals: 0, #Drums: 0]
  repeat with n = 1 to argChannelObjs.count
    chObj = argChannelObjs[n]
    if not objectp(chObj.m_loopObj_r) then
      next repeat
    end if
    if chObj.getSetting(#Mute) = 1 then
      next repeat
    end if
    if not objectp(chObj.channelMusicianObj.m_musician_r) then
      next repeat
    end if
    vol = chObj.getSetting(#vol)
    vol = vol / 100.0
    if vol < 0.20000000000000001 then
      next repeat
    end if
    instrumentID = chObj.m_loopObj_r.Instrument
    tmp = usedInst.getaProp(instrumentID)
    if voidp(tmp) then
      tmp = 0
    end if
    usedInst.setaProp(instrumentID, tmp + 1)
  end repeat
  if (usedInst.getaProp(#Guitar) = 0) and (usedInst.getaProp(#Keyboards) = 0) and (usedInst.getaProp(#Bass) = 1) then
    SongType = SongType - 0.10000000000000001
  end if
  if (usedInst.getaProp(#Guitar) = 0) and (usedInst.getaProp(#Keyboards) = 0) and (usedInst.getaProp(#Bass) = 0) then
    SongType = SongType - 0.20000000000000001
    quality = quality - 0.29999999999999999
    musStyle_r.Metal = musStyle_r.Metal - 0.20000000000000001
    musStyle_r.rock = musStyle_r.rock - 0.10000000000000001
  end if
  if (usedInst.getaProp(#Guitar) = 0) and (usedInst.getaProp(#Keyboards) >= 1) then
    musStyle_r.Metal = musStyle_r.Metal - 0.29999999999999999
    musStyle_r.rock = musStyle_r.rock - 0.10000000000000001
  end if
  if usedInst.getaProp(#Guitar) = 2 then
    musStyle_r.Metal = musStyle_r.Metal + 0.10000000000000001
    musStyle_r.rock = musStyle_r.rock + 0.10000000000000001
  else
    if usedInst.getaProp(#Guitar) >= 3 then
      musStyle_r.Metal = musStyle_r.Metal + 0.10000000000000001
      musStyle_r.rock = musStyle_r.rock + 0.10000000000000001
    end if
  end if
  if usedInst.getaProp(#Bass) = 0 then
    quality = quality - 0.10000000000000001
  else
    if usedInst.getaProp(#Bass) = 2 then
    else
      if usedInst.getaProp(#Bass) >= 3 then
        SongType = SongType - 0.10000000000000001
      end if
    end if
  end if
  if usedInst.getaProp(#Drums) = 0 then
    SongType = SongType - 0.10000000000000001
    quality = quality - 0.10000000000000001
    musStyle_r.Boring = musStyle_r.Boring + 0.10000000000000001
  else
    if usedInst.getaProp(#Drums) = 2 then
      musStyle_r.Metal = musStyle_r.Metal + 0.10000000000000001
      musStyle_r.Dance = musStyle_r.Dance + 0.10000000000000001
    else
      if usedInst.getaProp(#Drums) >= 3 then
        SongType = SongType - 0.20000000000000001
        quality = quality - 0.10000000000000001
      end if
    end if
  end if
  if usedInst.getaProp(#Keyboards) = 1 then
    musStyle_r.Pop = musStyle_r.Pop + 0.10000000000000001
  else
    if usedInst.getaProp(#Keyboards) = 2 then
      musStyle_r.Pop = musStyle_r.Pop + 0.20000000000000001
    else
      if usedInst.getaProp(#Keyboards) >= 3 then
        SongType = SongType - 0.14999999999999999
        musStyle_r.Pop = musStyle_r.Pop + 0.20000000000000001
      end if
    end if
  end if
  if usedInst.getaProp(#Vocals) = 0 then
    SongType = SongType - 0.14999999999999999
    musStyle_r.Boring = musStyle_r.Boring + 0.10000000000000001
    SongType = SongType - 0.20000000000000001
    quality = quality - 0.20000000000000001
  end if
  argAlbum_r.SongType = argAlbum_r.SongType + SongType
  argAlbum_r.quality = argAlbum_r.quality + quality
end

        end if
      end if

      Info[#val] = float(float(Info[#val]) - rng[#min]) / diff

  end repeat
  itemLists.add([#ID: #BG, #ch: 1, #type: #Pic, #Pic: bgPic, #inOffsetRect: [0, 0, 0, 0], #rel: [0, 0, #Auto, #Auto]])
  tmpLoc = point(30, 0)

on renderQueue me
  renderStrings = []
  m_rendered = [:]
  bigRenderStr = EMPTY
  repeat with n = 1 to m_queued.count
    ID = m_queued.getPropAt(n)
    Info = m_queued[n]
    inputPath = m_slicedPath & Info[#file] & "\" & "*.*"
    if 0 then
      if isFolderEmpty(m_slicedPath & Info[#file] & "\") then
        pott("Doesn't exist", Info[#file])
        next repeat
      end if
    else
      if fileExists2(m_slicedPath & Info[#file] & ".wav") = 0 then
        pott("Doesn't exist", Info[#file])
        next repeat
      end if
    end if
    outputPath = Info[#file]
    outputPath = fileStripName(outputPath)
    outputPath = m_renderToPath & string(ID) & ".wav"
    tmpFileObj = xtra("FileIO").new()
    tmpFileObj.openFile(outputPath, 0)
    if tmpFileObj.status() = 0 then
      delete tmpFileObj
      tmpFileObj.closeFile()
    end if
    tmpInfo = Info[#Switches].duplicate()
    tmpInfo[#in] = inputPath
    tmpInfo[#Out] = outputPath
    if m_useDll then
      renderStr = mixGenFXStr(tmpInfo, #dll)
      renderStrings.add(renderStr)
    else
      renderStr = mixGenFXStr(tmpInfo, #Exe)
      off = offset(inputPath, renderStr)
      renderStr = renderStr.char[off..renderStr.length]
      bigRenderStr = bigRenderStr & renderStr & RETURN & numToChar(10)
    end if
    m_rendered.setaProp(ID, outputPath)
  end repeat
  if m_useDll then
    if renderStrings.count = 0 then
      exit
    end if
    mixCallRockWave(renderStrings)
  else
    if m_queued.count = 0 then
      open(m_exePath && bigRenderStr.line[1])
    else
      batchFile = m_batchFilePath & "batch.txt"
      writeFile(batchFile, bigRenderStr)
      open(m_exePath && "/batch:" & batchFile)
    end if
  end if
  m_queued = [:]
  if m_useDll then
    if m_doWhatWhenDoneList.count then
      m_maxWait = the milliSeconds + integer(10.0 * 1000)
      m_waitUntilMsecs = the milliSeconds + 0
      gUseful.frameTimer.addObject(me)
    end if
  else
    if m_doWhatWhenDoneList.count then
      m_waitUntilMsecs = the milliSeconds + 500
      gUseful.frameTimer.addObject(me)
    end if
  end if
end

  tmp = m_rendered.getaProp(argID)
  if voidp(tmp) then
    return argAltFileName
  end if
  return tmp
end

on timeTick me
  if the milliSeconds > m_waitUntilMsecs then
    tmpImDone = 1
    tmpFileObj = xtra("FileIO").new()
    repeat with n = m_rendered.count() down to 1
      tmpFileObj.openFile(m_rendered[n], 0)
      if tmpFileObj.status() = 0 then
        tmpFileObj.closeFile()
        next repeat
      end if
      tmpImDone = 0
      exit repeat
    end repeat
    if tmpImDone = 0 then
      if the milliSeconds > m_maxWait then
      else
        m_waitUntilMsecs = the milliSeconds + 500
        exit
      end if
    end if
    if objectp(m_doWhatWhenDoneList[#ReportTo]) then
      tmpHandler = m_doWhatWhenDoneList[#handler]
      if voidp(tmpHandler) then
        tmpHandler = #Report
      end if
      if m_doWhatWhenDoneList[#ReportTo].handler(tmpHandler) then
        call(tmpHandler, m_doWhatWhenDoneList[#ReportTo])
      end if
    end if
    gUseful.frameTimer.deleteObject(me)
  end if
end

  else
    if m_fxName = #phaser then
      m_ctrlRanges = [#Mix: [#range: [#min: 0.0, #max: 1.0]], #depth: [#range: [#min: 0, #max: 10]], #freq: [#range: [#min: 0.0, #max: 2.5]]]

  end if

on getCtrlSetting me, argID
  val = m_ctrlVals[argID]
  if (m_fxName = #phaser) and (argID = #freq) then
    val = 1.0 - val
  end if
  tmpRangeInfo = m_ctrlRanges.getaProp(argID)
  if listp(tmpRangeInfo) then
    rng = tmpRangeInfo[#range]
    diff = rng[#max] - rng[#min]
    val = (val * diff) + rng[#min]
  end if
  return val
end

on mouse me, argObj, argWhat, argOption
  if argWhat = #click then

        end if
        m_waitingForRenderer = 1
        m_renderProtectMouseObj = script("MouseObject").new(me, rect(0, 0, 1000, 1000), [#layer: 1000000, #noPassRoll: 1, #cursorRoll: #wait])
        FX = m_channel.getEffects(m_loop_r)

        if argOption.ID = #ButtonCancel then
          m_channel.prepareLoop(m_loop_r)
          m_channel.Report(me, #ClosedFX)
          me.kill()
        else
          if argOption.ID = #Pic then

              me.changeLoop(-1)

              if argOption.ID = #ArrowDown then
